facts.fact: Sponsored Products are cost-per-click (CPC) ads that promote individual product listings on Amazon and select premium apps and websites.
facts.quote: Sponsored Products are cost-per-click (CPC) ads

facts.fact: You can create a Sponsored Products campaign in just a few minutes with image or video creative.
facts.quote: create a campaign in just a few minutes

facts.fact: New professional sellers can earn up to $1000 in ad credits when they launch and spend on Sponsored Products within 30 days.
facts.quote: New sellers can earn up to $1000 in ad credits

facts.fact: Ad credit offers are available in select marketplaces for Sponsored Products.
facts.quote: Available in select marketplaces

facts.fact: You select products to advertise and choose keywords to target, or let Amazon systems target relevant keywords automatically.
facts.quote: select products to advertise and choose keywords

facts.fact: You control how much you want to spend on bids and budgets and can measure ad performance.
facts.quote: control how much you want to spend on bids and budgets

facts.fact: Sponsored Products ads appear as image or as long-form interactive video.
facts.quote: appear as an image or, with video

facts.fact: Sponsored Products ads serve on desktop and mobile browsers as well as the Amazon mobile app.
facts.quote: serve both on desktop and mobile browsers

facts.fact: When customers click a Sponsored Products ad, they go directly to the advertised product detail page.
facts.quote: go to the advertised product detail page

facts.fact: Sponsored Products ads appear at the top of, alongside, or within shopping results and on product pages.
facts.quote: displayed at the top of, alongside, or within shopping results

facts.fact: Sponsored Products ads appear beyond Amazon on Amazon-owned sites and third-party destinations.
facts.quote: appear on the Amazon store and beyond

facts.fact: Sponsored Products supports browser and app experiences across desktop, mobile, and tablet devices.
facts.quote: support for browser and app experiences across devices

facts.fact: Sponsored Products takes shoppers directly to the product detail page to boost sales of individual products.
facts.quote: takes shoppers directly to the product detail page

facts.fact: Sponsored Products ads only appear when advertised items are in stock.
facts.quote: Only appear when your advertised items are in stock

facts.fact: Sponsored Products ads show multiple product features using images and video to help customers make informed decisions.
facts.quote: show multiple product features using images and video

facts.fact: Sponsored Products offers flexible keyword and product targeting options and recommendations.
facts.quote: Select from flexible keyword and product targeting options

facts.fact: With Sponsored Products you pay only for clicks and can refine campaigns using reporting insights.
facts.quote: pay only for clicks, and refine your campaigns

facts.fact: Sponsored Products campaigns with video saw 67% higher click-through rate compared to campaigns without video.
facts.quote: +67% higher click-through-rate (CTR)

facts.fact: Sponsored Products campaigns with video saw 9% higher conversion rate compared to campaigns without video.
facts.quote: +9% higher conversion rate (CVR)

facts.fact: Sponsored Products are available for professional sellers, vendors, book vendors, KDP authors, and agencies.
facts.quote: available for professional sellers, vendors, book vendors

facts.fact: Products must be in eligible categories and eligible for the Featured Offer to advertise with Sponsored Products.
facts.quote: must be in one or more eligible categories

facts.fact: Sponsored Products campaigns have no monthly or upfront fees.
facts.quote: have no monthly or upfront fees

facts.fact: With Sponsored Products you bid the maximum amount willing to pay when a shopper clicks your ad.
facts.quote: bid the maximum amount willing to pay when a shopper clicks

facts.fact: More competitive Sponsored Products bids increase likelihood of ad display when matching customer shopping queries.
facts.quote: more competitive your bid, the more likely your ad is to be displayed

facts.fact: Sponsored Products provides tools and reports to help optimize campaign performance and measure success.
facts.quote: provide a range of tools and reports to help optimize

facts.fact: Sponsored Products reports provide insight on sales and performance of advertised products or targets.
facts.quote: provide insight on sales and performance of advertised products

facts.fact: Sponsored Products reports show how different ad placements are performing.
facts.quote: how different ad placements are performing

facts.fact: Adult products, used products, refurbished products, and products in closed categories are not eligible for Sponsored Products advertising.
facts.quote: adult products, used products, refurbished products

facts.fact: For Sponsored Products you enter a bid for keywords you want to target.
facts.quote: enters a bid for the keywords that they want to target

facts.fact: A bid in Sponsored Products is the maximum amount you are willing to pay when a customer clicks your ad.
facts.quote: maximum amount you are willing to pay when a customer clicks

facts.fact: For Sponsored Products you set a daily budget for your campaign.
facts.quote: set a daily budget for your campaign

facts.fact: The Sponsored Products daily budget is a daily amount willing to spend on a campaign over a calendar month.
facts.quote: daily budget is a daily amount you are willing to spend

facts.fact: Sponsored Products daily budgets are not paced throughout the day and could be spent quickly if high demand.
facts.quote: Daily budgets are not paced throughout the day

facts.fact: The final Sponsored Products cost will never exceed the total amount set for the campaign duration.
facts.quote: final cost will never be more than the amount youve set

facts.fact: You can increase or decrease your Sponsored Products daily budget once your ads are live.
facts.quote: increase or decrease your daily budget once your ads are live

facts.fact: To create Sponsored Products you register for sponsored ads, sign in, click Create campaign and choose Sponsored Products.
facts.quote: Register for sponsored ads, click Create campaign

facts.fact: To create Sponsored Products you add products to advertise, define targeting and bidding strategies, and set campaign name, dates, and daily budget.
facts.quote: Add the products, define targeting, keyword, and bidding
